div.head: I Cn 5.1
div.ab: Gif man deacon tihtlige, þe regollice libbe, anfealdre spæce, nime twegen his gehadan ⁊ ladige hine mid þam.
Gif man diacon tihlige, þe reollice libbe, anfealdre spræce, nime twegen his gehadan ⁊ ladige hine mid þam.
Diaconus regularis in simplici compellatione cum duobus,
Si autem diaconus qui regulariter uiuit calumniatur simpla appellatione, acceptis duobus diaconibus secum, purget se.
Quodsi diaconus regularis uite simplici causa accusatus fuerit, assumat duos suos pares et cum illis ipse tertius se purget;
Gif man deacon tihtlige þe regollice libbe anfealdre spæce, nime twegen his gehadan ⁊ ladige hine mid þam.
Gif man deacon tihtlige, þe regollice libbe, anfealdre spæce, nime twegen his gehadan and ladige hine mid þam.
Wenn ein Diakon, der kanonisch lebt, mit einfacher Anklage bezichtigt wird, so nehme er zwei seiner Standesgenossen und reinige sich mit denen.
If a deacon who lives according to a rule is charged with a simple accusation, let him take two of his fellow-clergy and clear himself with them.
If a simple accusation is brought against a deacon who lives according to a rule, he shall take two supporters of the same ecclesiastical rank and clear himself with their help.
If a simple accusation is brought against a deacon who lives according to a rule, he is to take two clerics of his rank and exculpate himself with them.
